scope: Full standard-user startup + scan + complete durable CSV export; 100 candidate review, seven implemented changes. Remaining ordering is profiling priority, not a measured savings ranking.
method: Do not add overlapping savings. Current n=10 results determine total improvement; cold cache is uncontrolled. Candidates without evidence are not called safe wins. The existing earlier 100-point audit is separate historical work.

rows.candidate: Batch allocation, timestamps and file identities per directory
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: Replace roughly 1.65 million file opens/metadata queries with directory-sized batches; exploratory n=10 engine median 16.8 s versus prior 60.8 s. This includes cache differences, not an isolated causal estimate.
rows.evidence: directory_metadata.rs; allocation.rs; existing scanner fanout/cancellation tests

rows.candidate: Decode names directly from the aligned directory buffer
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: Remove one temporary UTF-16 vector per name; 3000-name cumulative allocation 435009 -> 261003 bytes.
rows.evidence: performance.rs::batched_names_use_one_owned_utf16_copy_per_entry

rows.candidate: Store volume identifiers once per identity set
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: 100k identities: cumulative allocation 8650876 -> approximately 4456880 bytes before the next optimization.
rows.evidence: performance.rs::physical_identity_budget_stores_volume_once_instead_of_per_file

rows.candidate: Store common 64-bit identities compactly with full 128-bit fallback
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: 100k identities: cumulative allocation falls from 4456880 to below 2600000 bytes; wide identities remain distinct.
rows.evidence: performance.rs::common_64_bit_file_identities_fit_a_compact_budget_without_truncating_wide_ids

rows.candidate: Shard parallel physical-storage accounting
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: Replace one scan-wide identity lock with 64 independent locks. CPU/time savings require final n=10 measurement; cannot be attributed separately from batching.
rows.evidence: allocation_tracker.rs::simultaneous_hardlink_claims_allocate_storage_exactly_once

rows.candidate: Skip identity storage and locking for zero allocation
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: Avoid a hash insertion/lock for every zero-allocation record. Count and time benefit depend on the volume; no logical file is skipped.
rows.evidence: allocation_tracker.rs::physical_storage_claims_preserve_volume_and_full_128_bit_identity

rows.candidate: Batch atomic export writes in a 1 MiB buffer
rows.risk: low on the tested Windows NTFS workflow; supported API fallback and correctness checks retained
rows.estimated_savings: 32 MiB output: 4096 -> 32 OS disk write operations; +approximately 1 MiB transient memory per active export. Durability and atomic replacement retained.
rows.evidence: output_performance.rs::large_atomic_exports_batch_disk_writes_and_preserve_the_complete_output
